name: Parshwanath Corporation Ltd
about: Incorporated in 1967, Parshwanath Corporation is engaged in the business of construction and development of residential and commercial projects in India.
keyPoints:
Business Overview:[1]
Company is a part of Parshwanath Group which is comprised of 4 firms namely Shree Parshwanath Corporation, Parshwanath Realty Pvt. Ltd., Parshwanath Corporation, Parshwanath Corporation Ltd. Company is associated with more than 123 projects, 21,000 Unit, 1,41,78,000 sq.ft. of built up spaces & 2,92,78,000 sq.ft of land development in Ahmedabad.

cons: Though the company is reporting repeated profits, it is not paying out dividend
Company has a low return on equity of 3.52% over last 3 years.
Working capital days have increased from 91.3 days to 193 days
